association.name: St. Philomena's College Alumni Association
association.tagline: Fostering Lifelong Connections, Global Networking & Student Mentorship
association.description: St. Philomena's College Alumni Association (SPCAA) unites over seven decades of graduates across the globe. Our alumni community provides active student mentorship, merit scholarships, campus infrastructure support, and professional networking chapters across India and abroad.
objectives: To foster an enduring bond between the Alma Mater and its alumni worldwide.
To mentor current undergraduate and postgraduate students in industry trends, competitive exams, and career pathways.
To sponsor scholarships, financial aid, and research equipment for meritorious and underprivileged students.
To organize annual global reunions, regional chapter meets, and distinguished alumni lectures.

courses: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc - Life Sciences / Biotech / BioChem)
Bachelor of Arts (BA - Humanities / Journalism / Economics)
Bachelor of Vocation (B.Voc - Digital Media / Healthcare)
departments: Department of Languages (Kannada / Hindi / French / Malayalam)
